Commentary.Commentary: 237 to win in 50 overs, then. Does not look a very big total, to be honest, but a couple of early wickets and you never know with India's ever-so-fragile middle order. Australia will hope for exactly the same. Meanwhile, the hosts will know that a good opening stand will set the platform for a comfortable chase. What will happen? Join us in a short while for the second innings to find out!

Kuldeep says that the first 10 overs of the innings were very crucial. Mentions that the fast bowlers picking up wickets and keeping it tight helped the spinners. Adds that he used the first two overs to get back into the rhythm as he was coming back into the action after a 20-day break. Reckons that the wicket is a little slow and it is difficult to play spin. Informs that he realized the wicket is slow after bowling a couple of overs and hence he bowled at a slower pace post that. When asked about his loop, he states that Khawaja was coming down the track and that's why he kept tossing it up. Feels Handscomb's wicket was special. Signs off by admitting that he practices different variations in the nets and tries to deceive the batsmen with the wrong 'uns.

With the ball, the stars were Shami and Kuldeep who both picked up 2 wickets each while being economical as well. Shami was especially really good at the start. Jadeja bowled a wicketless spell but went at a run rate of 3.3 per over only. It was a rare bad day at the office for Jasprit Bumrah but the rest of his colleagues ensured that the team did not suffer. A good bowling display on the whole. Time for an interview, Kuldeep Yadav on the sidelines...

Aaron Finch won the toss but could not do much with the bat as he trudged off for a third ball duck and continued with his string of low scores. That though was followed by a hard-fought partnership of 87 between Usman Khawaja and Marcus Stoinis, who walked in at number 3. But just when it seemed like the Aussies were accelerating, the partnership-breaker Kedar Jadhav came to the fore picking the wicket of Stoinis. Khawaja went on to reach his fifty but could not continue longer as he holed out in the deep. Handscomb too fell after getting a start. The star of the T20Is, Glenn Maxwell reached 40 at a decent clip but fell at the wrong time for the visitors. At that time, it seemed like it would be really hard for the away side to bat out the entire 50 overs but a decent partnership in the end of 62 runs between Nathan Coulter-Nile and Alex Carey for the seventh wicket gave the total some respectability and the Aussie bowlers something to play with.

A stop and start innings from Australia. They will be disappointed having ended at least 25-30 runs short of the total that they would have liked, especially after winning the toss and electing to bat on this decent surface in Hyderabad. And more so when Jasprit Bumrah had a rare off day. Kudos though have to be given to Kuldeep Yadav, Ravindra Jadeja and mainly, Mohammed Shami who bowled economically while picking up wickets at regular interval as well. They never let the Aussies off the hook and kept the scoring rate under control right through the innings.

Just a single to end! A good over though for the Australians as 10 comes from it. Carey again makes room but the bowler follows him. Alex ends up chopping it to the keeper for a run. AUSTRALIA END ON 236 FOR 7!
Pat Cummins will walk out to the middle for the last delivery. He will be at the non-striker's end though.

OUT! Nathan Coulter-Nile holes out! Bumrah bangs it short and on the body, Nathan looks to pull but it hits the higher portion of the bat and goes straight down the throat of Kohli at long on. The good thing though is the batsmen have crossed and Carey will be on strike.
A single now as Carey opens the face and guides it to point.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Carey does the smart thing now, stands still. Bumrah bowls it on the pads. Alex whips it through square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Much, much needed. They need a few more. Short and outside off, it is the slower one again. Carey looks to cut but gets an outside edge to the third man fence.
Brilliant slower one outside off, Carey is done in completely and misses the ball. 6 dots in Bumrah's last 7 balls. Brilliant at this stage of the innings.
Good length delivery on off, Carey defends it. Shami stops it and the ball goes to his right. He is lazy to get to the spilled ball and they steal a single. 6 runs off the over.

FOUR! Poor fielding from Bumrah at short third man. Shami looks for a wide yorker and in a rare moment today he misses it. He serves up a full toss outside off, Carey looks to hit it on the off side but gets a thick outside edge. Bumrah dives to his right and misfields it and the ball then goes past him away for a boundary.
Full length delivery on middle and leg, Nathan hits it towards long on and takes a run.
Fuller length delivery on off, Coulter-Nile hits it wide of Shikhar Dhawan at deep cover and they get a couple.
Slower delivery on off, Carey checks his shot and luckily for him it falls short of the mid off fielder and takes a single.
Good length delivery on off, Carey moves across and looks to hit it to the on side. He misreads the pace and the ball lobs up towards point after hitting his pad.
Ends the over with a dot too! Just a single from the 48th over. Another slower ball and outside off, Nathan guides it to point. Top, top stuff from Bumrah.
Another dot! Slower ball outside off, Coulter-Nile opens the face of the bat and guides it to short third man. The idea was right from NCN but the execution was not there.
Just a single now as Carey pushes it down to long on.
Three dots in a row now! Carey makes room but Bumrah bowls it closer to the batsman. He tries to hit it over cover but misses.
Two dots in a row as Carey defends the ball on the stumps.
Outside off, Carey looks to play at it away from his body but gets beaten.

FOUR! Great shot. Full length delivery outside off. It is in the slot for Coulter-Nile to swing his arm. He slices it over the mid off fielder and the ball goes away to the fence. 13 runs off the over.

In the air...but falls safe. Slower delivery on a length. Coulter-Nile goes for the pull. It hits him high on his bat and goes way up in the sky. Vijay Shankar runs to his right from long on but cannot get there. Two runs taken by the batsmen.
On the pads, Alex flicks it towards fine leg for a single.

FOUR! Powerful. Full length delivery on middle and leg. Carey moves his front leg out of the line and whacks it past the diving mid off fielder for a boundary. Only his second boundary of the innings.
Yorker on off, Coulter-Nile manages to guide it towards third man for a single. Shami has hit the spot at will today.
Good length delivery on off, Carey guides it towards cover and gets to the other end.
Slower ball and Carey pushes it towards mid off for a run. A single to end, 7 from this over.
Good length on off, Carey guides it towards point.
Very full and on middle, Nathan hits it down to long on for a run.

FOUR! Off the inside edge but Australia will take everything that comes their way. Full and wide outside off, Nathan throws his bat at it, the ball goes off the inside edge, past the off pole and down to the fine leg fence. 200 up for Australia, 4 overs to go after this one. How many more can they get?
Works it with the angle towards mid-wicket and sets off for a run. The fielder there hits bull's eye at the striker's end but Nathan was well home.
Back of a length on middle, Carey keeps it out.
Jasprit Bumrah is back into the attack. He has figures of 7-0-42-1 so far.
Good length delivery on the pads, Alex flicks it towards backward square leg for a run. 4 runs off the over.
Yorker this time on middle and leg, Nathan does well to guide it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Meanwhile, a Mexican wave going on in the crowd!
Full length delivery on off, Coulter-Nile looks to hit it across the line but gets a thick inside edge onto his front pad.
Back of a length on off, Carey runs it down towards third man and rotates the strike.
Full length delivery on middle this time, Coulter-Nile flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Full length delivery on off, Coulter-Nile defends it.
Two dots to end Kuldeep's spell! Flighted ball on off, Carey finds the man at cover. Yet another excellent day in the office for Yadav. He finishes with figures of 10-0-46-2.

An appeal but not given! The leg spinner from him on off, Carey gets outside the line of off stump and looks to reverse. He misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head. Kuldeep likes it but Dhoni feels it is not worth reviewing. Kohli listens to Dhoni and does not do so. The Hawk Eye also shows  the impact was in line but the ball was turning away from the off pole.
Well played in the end! First goes to sweep but Kuldeep bowls it very full. Nathan then tries to jam it out but ends up hitting it uppishly past the bowler for a run.
Slower through the air on off, Carey strokes it square on the off side for a run.
Another short one, this time NCN picks it and he slaps it through covers for a run.

A couple! Fortunate one though. The googly but it is on the shorter side, it pitches around off and then turns away. Coulter-Nile first thinks of cutting it but then seeing the ball turn away looks to bail out. The ball though hits the bottom of his bat, goes between the legs of Dhoni and two runs are taken.
Dot ball to finish the over. Flighted on the stumps, Carey blocks it.
FOUR! Tossed up delivery on middle, Carey brings out the reverse sweep and connects it well to send it to the fence at backward point for a boundary.
Flighted on off, Alex pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Straighter one on outside off, Carey leaves it alone.
Full on middle and leg, Nathan pushes it towards mid on for a single.
On the pads, Carey flicks it towards square leg and looks for two. The fielder though gets there quickly so he has to be happy with a single.
Kedar Jadhav is on now.
The googly again but this one pitches outside leg pole. Coulter-Nile looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head. Pitched outside leg.
The yorker and Coulter-Nile pushes it back to the bowler.
Manages to drag the ball from outside off, through square leg for a run.
Short and on middle from around the wicket. NCN goes back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
The googly and Nathan fails to pick it. He tries to go back and defend but is comprehensibly beaten.
Flighted ball and outside off, NCN keeps it out.
Kuldeep Yadav is back on now. He has figures of 8-0-39-2 so far.
Length delivery outside off, Alex looks to cut it but gets beaten. 6 runs off the over.
Good length delivery outside off, Nathan follows the boundary with a single towards cover.
FOUR! No power there just uses the pace of the ball. Full length delivery on middle and leg, Coulter-Nile just shows the face of the bat and pushes it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Swing and a miss. Good length delivery outside off, Coulter-Nile swings his bat at it but misses.
Full length delivery on the pads, Alex flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
On a length and around off, Carey blocks it out.
Powerplay 3 begins, India can now have 5 fielders outside the 30-yard circle. Also, Jasprit Bumrah is back on.

And just like his last ball in the last over, this too is a yorker to welcome the new batsman. Coulter-Nile manages to get his bat down in time and keeps it out. Another top over by Shami comes to an end.
Nathan Coulter-Nile walks out to the crease.

OUT! The Big Show is out of here and Australia are now in big, big trouble! Shami gets his second and once again it is on the 5th ball of the over. He lands this one on a length around off, it pitches and comes back in a shade. Maxwell looks to drive it on the up but leaves a gap between bat and pad. It sneaks through and rattles the off pole. The crowd here erupts as they also know it is a massive breakthrough for the home team. 250 now looks farfetched as India are into the bowling all-rounders.
Wide! Slower ball and it is down the leg side. Maxwell looks to pull but misses. It has been wided.
Four dots as once again Maxwell flicks it nicely but finds the man at mid-wicket.
Slightly fuller this time, Maxwell looks to drive but it hits the bottom part of his bat and goes to mid off. Three dots in a row!
Whips it nicely but finds the man at mid-wicket.
Back of a length on off, Maxwell gets right behind the line and keeps it out.
Looped up delivery on off, this time Maxwell hits it wide of the cover fielder and gets a single. Jadeja is done for the day with the ball and he finishes off with the figures of 10-0-33-0.
Flighted on off, Maxwell pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Tossed up delivery on off, Carey gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards backward square leg for a single. Kedar Jadhav comes running from square leg and does well to keep it down to a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Carey defends it off his front foot.
Jadeja lands it on off, this time Maxwell hits it wide of the cover fielder and gets to the other end.
Flighted on off, Maxwell hits it to the fielder at point.
Welcomes the new batsman with a yorker! Carey jams it out. End of a successful over by Shami.
Alex Carey is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! The debutant falls after getting a start. It seemed like Shami bowled a slower one but the speed gun shows 135 kph. It is on the shorter side. Not very short though. Turner goes for the pull but the ball does not bounce as much as he expected it to. It goes off the inside edge and onto the stumps. Another partnership which was looking good is cut short. Frustrating this for the Aussies but good for the Indians. They now have half of Australia's side back in the hut.
Goes very full and on the pads, Turner flicks it away from the fine leg fielder and takes two.
Good fielding from Chahal, the sub, at mid off. Maxwell strokes it right off the middle and on the up towards mid off. Chahal there runs to his left and stops it with a dive. Can't stop a run though.
Cramps the batsman for room by bowling it on his body, Ashton looks to punch but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards square leg for a quick run.
Good running! Maxwell pushes it off the back foot towards mid on and gets to the other end.
Loopy delivery on middle, Maxwell runs it to long on and keeps the strike with a single.
Lands it on off, Ashton nudges it towards cover and gets to the other end.
Flighted on off, Turner hits it to the point fielder.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Glenn pushes it towards long on and takes a single.
Quicker one outside off, Maxwell looks to drive it on the off side but misses.
Flatter on the pads, Maxwell hits it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
A good delivery to end the over! Just a biggie and five dots from it. Length and this one deviates away just a little. Turner looks to hit it on the up but gets beaten.
Back of a length on off, Turner goes back and guides it towards point where Jadeja makes a good stop.
Another dot as Turner strokes it towards covers.
A good comeback! Shami bends his back on this one and lands it on a length around middle. It comes back in after landing, hits the thigh pad of Turner as it deflects to point.

SIX! What a shot! He got his first boundary in ODIs in the last over and now his first maximum. The slower bumper, Turner picks it early. He goes back and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence. A maximum early in the over, Australia now need to make this count.
Good length on off, Turner keeps it out. A dot to begin Shami's new spell.

DRINKS! India continue to remain on top but Australia have Glenn Maxwell out there who is looking good. Turner here has a good chance to show what he is capable of. 15 more overs to go and the Aussies will be aiming for something around 270 but for that to happen, they need the two batsmen out there to continue at least till the 45th over. India, on the other hand, know a couple of wickets here, especially that of the 'Big Show' and the visitors might just struggle to get to 240. Mohammed Shami to bowl after the Drinks break.
Full on middle and leg, Ashton keeps the strike by milking it towards long on for a single. 7 runs off the over.
Flighted on off, Turner follows the boundary with a dot by pushing it towards point.
FOUR! Shorter on off, Turner picks the length early and rocks onto his back foot. He keeps his balance and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary, his first in ODI cricket.
Shorter on middle and leg, Maxwell tucks it towards deep mid-wicket and picks up a single. 150 up for Australia.
On middle and leg, Maxwell helps it to the fielder at square leg.
Flatter on off and middle, Turner nudges it towards deep cover and takes a single.
Short again, Maxwell tries to do the same he did two balls ago but can't find the gap this time.
Gives it a little more air, Maxwell blocks it out.
FOUR! This should break the shackles! On the shorter side, Maxwell goes back and then punches it through covers. He finds the gap and a boundary results.
The googly, Maxwell hits it back to the bowler.
On the shorter side, Turner has enough time to read which way the ball is turning. He then pushes it down to long off for a run.
Flighted ball on middle, Maxwell times it through mid off and takes a run.
Single to end the over. Shorter on off, Glenn pushes it towards point and gets a single.
Flighted on off, Maxwell pushes it to the fielder at mid off.
Once again shorter in length, Glenn blocks it off his back foot.
Shorter on the body of Maxwell. He defends it off his back foot.
Flighted on off and middle, Turner drives it straight towards long off for a single.
On off, Turner hits it straight to the fielder at point.
Flighted outside off and Ashton pushes it back towards long off with a straight bat as he keeps strike for the next over.
Really full on the legs, Glenn pushes it away to mid-wicket for a run.
Delivered shorter this time on the pads, worked away for a single through square leg by Turner.
Flatter one outside off, pushed to cover.
Looped up outside off, Turner reaches out without much foot movement and looks to push the ball to long off but the ball goes off the inside half and towards mid-wicket.
Lots of flight outside off, Maxwell comes onto his front foot and takes the ball on the full as he drives it wide of extra cover for a single.
Glenn now eases it down to long off and takes a single. Just three from this over, Jadeja continues to keep it tight.
On the pads, Maxwell works it towards mid-wicket.
Maxwell strokes it towards cover. Turner is off for a run but is sent back rightly.
First run in ODIs for Turner as he gets it by pushing it down to long off.
Maxwell this time opens the face and hits it through covers for a run.
This is fired on the stumps, the batter goes back and pushes it to cover.
Ashton Turner, the debutant, is the new man in. 20 overs left, good time for him to show his capability. Also, Ravindra Jadeja is back on.

OUT! Stumped! Beaten in the air there! That is Kuldeep Yadav's guile and even a good player of spin like Handscomb has been done in. Yadav flights this one beautifully outside off and tempts the batsman to leave his crease. Peter is though nowhere close to the ball and the spin on the ball is too much. It goes through the gap between bat and pad towards Dhoni who collects and flicks off the bails in a flash. PH was at sea and had no chance of getting back. The budding partnership of 36 has been broken and it is a really good time for India to get this wicket, especially with a debutant deemed to bat next.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman towards cover.
Flighted on middle, Handscomb defends that off the front foot by presenting the full face of the bat.
Good stop! Flighted outside off and it's driven beautifully by Maxwell. Shankar at cover dives to his left and makes a great stop. Saves a certain boundary there.

Edged... In the air but lands well short of backward point! A flighted ball outside off and Maxwell reaches out again to drive the ball but this time it takes the outside edge and goes towards the backward point fielder.

FOUR! Maxwell is turning the heat on here! Kuldeep flights this one generously outside off and Glenn strides out and drives the ball in the gap between the two extra-covers in position. No one in the deep and the ball will have to be fetched back.
Back of a length and on the stumps, kept out. 10 runs from this over, another expensive one. Bumrah's not had a good second spell here.
Bowls it short to Maxwell and he pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Slower ball, PH waits for it and then guides it down to third man for a single.
FOUR! What a shot! This is outside off, there is not a lot of width on offer. Handscomb still manages to somehow guide it past the fielder at point and away from the fielder at third man. A boundary.

Good fielding! Saves a run for his side. On the stumps, Maxwell goes back and punches it back past the bowler. Rayudu from mid on, gives it a chase and manages to pull it back before it crosses the ropes.
Good length and outside off, Maxwell opens the face of the bat and strokes it through point for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Delightful! Just shows what form this guy is in. A little too full by Kuldeep, Maxwell leans into it and strokes it through extra cover. Dealing in boundaries is Maxwell.
Dances down the track and looks to whip it on the leg side, it is the googly so it goes off the leading edge down to long off for a single.
Very short, Handscomb pushes it to covers. Should have done better with that ball, should have got at least a run from it.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Handscomb cuts it to point.
Nearly! Peter uses his feet and looks to stroke it through the off side. The ball though turns back in, hits the inner half and lands short of Kuldeep.

FOUR! Edgy but Maxwell will take it. Full length delivery outside off. The ball comes in after pitching. Maxwell looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge. There is a slip in place for that kind of an edge. But Rohit Sharma at wide first slip reacts late. The ball goes past him to the third man fence for a boundary. Had he been at a conventional first slip position then Maxwell would have been a goner. Maxwell is in the form of his life and this could come back to haunt the Indian team here. Any half chance to get him out should be taken with both hands.
Follows the boundary with a dot ball. Good length delivery on off and middle, Maxwell gets on his back foot and defends it.

FOUR! Brilliant shot. Back of a length delivery outside off, Maxwell gets on his back foot and punches it through cover. Shikhar Dhawan comes running to his right in the deep and puts a dive to save it from going to the fence. He does well to get there but cannot stop it.
Play and a miss. Back of a length delivery outside off, Maxwell looks to drive it but misses and the ball goes past the outside edge to Dhoni behind the stumps.
Good length delivery on off, Peter guides it towards third man and gets to the other end.
Full length delivery outside off, Handscomb pushes it straight to the fielder at point.
Jasprit Bumrah back into the attack.
Slower through the air and around off, Maxwell blocks it out.
The googly and PH picks it, he strokes it down to long off for a run.
Now with a straight bat, Glenn strokes it down to long on for a single.
A full toss but Maxwell fails to put it away. Finds the man at covers.
Maxwell goes back and punches it towards cover where the fielder makes a good stop diving to his right. Saves a run.
Flighted and outside off, Handscomb looks to drag it through the leg side but gets it off the inner half through mid on for a run.
Single to end the over. On the pads, Handscomb nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Flatter on off, Peter hits it straight to the fielder at point.
Flighted on off, Maxwell is off the mark with a single towards long off. Also 100 up for Australia.
Shorter on middle, Maxwell hits it again to the same fielder.
Off spinner on middle and leg, Maxwell hits it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Full on the pads, Handscomb nudges it towards deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Uppish but well away from the fielder! Short and on middle, Handscomb pushes it down to long on for a run.
The in-form Glenn Maxwell walks out at number 5.

OUT! In the air... taken! Khawaja will have to wait for his maiden ODI ton. Another set batsman is back in the hut. Khawaja uses his feet and swings across the line. He connects well but not well enough to clear the boundary line at deep mid-wicket. Shankar there runs to his right and holds onto the catch with a slide. A very fine catch as Shankar had to cover good ground to his right. The bowling change has worked for the hosts and Australia are in a spot of bother here.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Continues bowling it short and flatter, Handscomb goes back and punches it down to long on for a run.
Flatter and on middle, PH pushes it back to the bowler.
Slower and a touch shorter outside off, Handscomb finds the man at point with the cut.
Kuldeep Yadav is back on.
Loopy off spinner on middle and leg, Handscomb nudges it towards mid-wicket and keeps the strike with a single.

Fifty! Finally Khawaja gets there. Shorter and on the pads, Khawaja easily nudges it towards fine leg to get to his 6th ODI fifty. He will be looking to convert this into a big one and get to his maiden century.
Flighted on the stumps, Usman defends it.
On middle and leg, Usman tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Shorter in length outside off, Khawaja cuts it to the fielder at point.
Full on off, Khawaja drives it uppishly but short of the fielder at mid off.
Very full, almost a yorker. Handscomb looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto his pads. Three dots to end.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On the stumps again, it is pushed back to the bowler.

Misfield and a couple! A lazy effort you can say. A little too full by Jadeja. Peter leans into it and strokes it through covers. Shankar should have done better. He fails to go down in time and the ball goes underneath his hand. Kohli does the mopping up job and keeps it down to two.
Flatter and on the stumps, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Tosses it up on off, Khawaja with the turn, hits it down to long on and gets to the other end.
On off, Khawaja pushes it towards cover and takes a single. Excellent over from Kedar Jadhav. Just 4 runs and the big wicket of Marcus Stoinis.
Shorter on off, Khawaja hits it to the fielder at cover.
Flatter and full on middle and leg, Handscomb pushes it towards long on for a single.
Reaches out for a full ball outside off and drives it through the line. It's a bit uppish but in the gap at cover-point for one.
Loopy and full on middle, Handscomb eases it down to long on and gets off the mark with a run.
Peter Handscomb is the new man in.

OUT! Number 87 strikes! The devil's number for a reason for Australia. The golden arm of Kedar Jadhav strikes again. Shorter off spinner on off and middle, bowled with a higher-arm action, Stoinis gets on his back foot to pull it flat and straight to the Indian skipper at short mid-wicket. He could have hit it anywhere but finds the fielder. It's travelling with the speed of light but Virat Kohli reacts quickly and takes a sharp catch. A much-needed wicket for India and Stoinis walks back disappointed.

Beaten all ends up! A lovely delivery by Jadeja. He drops it on a shortish length outside off and gets it to curve back in from there. Khawaja stands inside the crease clueless as he tries to push at it tamely. It turns back in, beats the inside edge and goes into the gloves of Dhoni.
Quicker and fuller on middle, Stoinis makes room and strokes it through covers for one.
Shortish again, outside off, Khawaja plays a late cut wide of short third man and pinches a single.
Flatter one, a touch short and on off, Stoinis moves back and hits it down to long on for a run.
Full and flighted on off, driven down the ground to long on for a run.
Short in length and outside off, cut from the back foot but straight to point.
Shorter on off, Stoinis taps it back to the bowler.
On the stumps and full, Marcus defends it.
Shorter on off, Usman punches it to the off side for a single.
Follows the boundary with a single. Tossed up on middle and leg, Marcus comes down the track and hits it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Jadhav. Sprays this down the leg side, Stoinis gets on one knee and sweeps it fine towards the fine leg region for a boundary.

BUMP BALL! Flighted delivery on middle, Stoinis comes down the track and hits it straight back towards Jadhav. He grabs it on his right side. The bowler and keeper appeal for catch. The umpires have a discussion and then go upstairs. Replay shows it bumped before it came to Jadhav.
Shout for a return catch! Is that a bump ball? India are appealing. The two umpires get together and then refer it upstairs. Soft signal is not out.
Fires one in on middle and leg, Stoinis turns it in front of square leg for a run.
Quicker one on off, full and skidding in, Marcus pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter and on off, Stoinis sticks back inside the crease in defense.
Tossed up ball outside off, Khawaja stretches forward and drives it through cover-point for one.
Uses his feet on this occasion but once again Khawaja flicks it to mid-wicket. Two dots.
Leans forward and across to a full ball and plays it with the spin to mid-wicket.
On the pads, Marcus finds the same fielder again with his flicks.
Off spinner on middle. Marcus nudges it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Arm ball on off, Usman milks it towards cover and rotates the strike.
Flighted on off, Khawaja drives it to the fielder at mid off.
Slower off spinner on middle, Stoinis tucks it to the on side for a side for a run.
Flighted outside off, Khawaja hits it towards deep cover and takes a single.

Drinks break! The Australians have come back nicely in the game after an early jolt. The current pair of Marcus Stoinis and Usman Khawaja have weathered the early pressure and are amidst a 72-run unbeaten stand at the moment. The Indian tweakers are just on now and will look to pick a few wickets quickly. The match is set up nicely here...
Dot to finish the over. Jadeja lands it on off. Marcus blocks it. Sir finishes his over in the blink of an eye. Just 1 from it.
Quicker on off, Marcus pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Once again shorter on off and middle, Stoinis punches it to the fielder at mid on.
Tossed up delivery on the stumps, Stoinis defends it.
Shorter this time on off, Khawaja hits it off his back foot towards long off for a single.
Flighted on middle and off, Khawaja tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Another decent over for Australia! A single to end as this is stroked through covers.
FOUR! Streaky but Australia won't care! Another flatter and shorter delivery outside off, Khawaja looks to cut but gets an outside edge through short third man for a boundary.

A couple! This is bowled down the leg side. Khawaja looks to sweep but seems to have missed it. It hits the gloves of Dhoni and then rolls towards fine leg. The batsmen run two. The umpire gives no signal so that is off the bat which means it is technically a dropped chance.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
This is quicker and flatter and way outside off but just inside the tramline. Khawaja looks to guide it very late but misses.
Slower through the air and outside off, Khawaja cuts it to point.
Kedar Jadhav, India's magic man, is now on.
A single to end this over as Khawaja works it around the corner.
Tosses it outside off again, this one turns back in and hence, hits the inside edge of the bat as Khawaja tries to hit it through covers. It rolls back to the bowler.
Very full and on off, Khawaja hits it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Innovation and it comes off! He brings out the reverse sweep, it is slightly short but Khawaja hits it by getting on top of the bounce. Hits it through point.
Flatter this time and it is on the off stump. Kept out.
Tosses it up outside off, Khawaja strokes it to covers.
Ravindra Jadeja is on now.
Length ball at the hips, flicked away for a single to deep backward square leg for a run by Khawaja as he keeps strike. 10 runs off this over.
Fuller outside off, driven for a single by Stoinis.
FOUR! Stoinis is milking the runs easily here. A length ball at a generous pace outside off, Marcus holds his position and smashes the ball right past mid off for a boundary. No stopping that!
Wayward ball on a length outside off, Marcus leaves it alone expecting it to be wided maybe. The umpire decides otherwise though.

FOUR! Shankar cannot bowl this length at his pace. Drags down the ball short and outside off. Stoinis has all the time in the world to go on the back foot and pull it away, wide of mid-wicket for a boundary. This brings up both the 50 for the batting team as well as the 50-run partnership between these two.
A good length ball outside off, Stoinis pushes it towards cover-point where an extra fielder had just been placed on the off side. It is like a second point.
A dot to end! This is flatter and a touch shorter. Turns away. Khawaja looks to keep it out but it goes off the outer half to point.
This is eased down to long off for a run.
Uses his feet but Kuldeep bowls it outside off, Khawaja pushes it through covers for a run.

That has been hit hard! Flighted ball on middle, Stoinis powers it towards long on. He is seen admiring his shot thinking it is a sure-shot boundary. Long on gets to his left quickly and stops it. The batsmen go for a run late and complete it.
Outside off, Stoinis leaves it alone.
On the pads, it is worked around the corner for a run.
Once again length delivery outside off, Stoinis cuts it straight to the fielder at point this time.
Follows the boundary with a dot ball. Length delivery outside off, Stoinis leaves it alone.

FOUR! Excellent shot. Good length delivery outside off but Shankar offers width to Stoinis. Marcus waits for it and cuts it late through point for a boundary. Runs beginning to flow now for Australia.

Length delivery on middle. The ball moves away from the southpaw after pitching. Khawaja looks to defend but gets surprised by the movement. He gets a thick outside edge and the ball goes towards covers for a single.
Good length delivery on the fifth stump line, Stoinis cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length and around off, Stoinis pushes it to covers.
Way too wide outside off, left alone. Wided.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
UK once again dances down the track but Kuldeep shortens his length. Khawaja adjusts and blocks it out. An expensive start from Kuldeep. 10 coming off the 10th over.

Oh close. Tossed up delivery on middle and leg, Khawaja comes down the track and looks to hit straight. He is lucky to get an inside edge and the ball goes towards the fine leg region. The batsmen get a brace.
Kuldeep may have understood that as he shortens the length. Khawaja pushes it to covers.

SIX! All the way! First of the game and it comes off the bat of Khawaja. They may have a plan here against Kuldeep. They see it tossed up, so they are using their feet. This time Khawaja gets to the pitch of it and hits it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Stoinis now uses his feet and works it down to long on for a single.
Straightaway uses his feet to the spinner and eases it down to long off for a single.
First sign of spin. Kuldeep Yadav introduced into the attack.
Another one outside off, another leave. 13 from the last two overs. Australia starting to get a move on here.
Continues offering width outside off, this time though the batsman makes a leave.
FOUR! Short, wide and Stoinis makes the bowler pay! He cuts it through point and fetches a boundary.
Hits the length again and gets some gentle away movement. Stoinis lets it be.
Length delivery outside off, Marcus leaves it alone.
Good length delivery outside off. Once again Stoinis shoulders arms to it.
Full length delivery outside off, Marcus leaves it alone as it's way down the tramline. Wide signalled.
Vijay Shankar replaces Mohammed Shami.
Beaten for the third time in this over! Another one outside off, Khawaja has a poke at it and gets beaten. An eventful over this and a good one in the end for Australia. 8 from it.

FOUR! Uppish but in the gap! Finds the gap through the point region this time! Second boundary in the over. This is full once again and width is on offer outside off. Khawaja goes after it but ends up slicing it through that region and into the fence.
Well fielded! India have their tails up at the moment! Short and wide outside off, UK cuts towards point. Jadeja there dives to his left and stops it. Saves a boundary there.
Good comeback by Bumrah! Length delivery again and outside off, Khawaja hangs his bat out and gets beaten.

FOUR! This should probably get Australia going! Bumrah bowls it full on this occasion and it is closer to the off pole. Khawaja leans into it and strokes it through the off side. Finds the gap through extra cover and a boundary results.
BEAUTY! Just unplayable! From around the wicket, it is angled into the off pole. It pitches and then straightens. Khawaja ends up playing inside the line and gets beaten.
Away swing on this one. It is on the fourth stump line, Marcus leaves it alone. Just 1 run off it. Shami has had a really good start here. 22 dot balls in his 4 overs so far.
Shami comes over the wicket to the right-hander. Fuller this time on off and middle, Stoinis defends it solidly off his front foot.
Back of a length delivery on off, Khawaja gets to the other end by guiding it towards third man.
Good shot but for no run. Full length delivery on off and middle. Usman flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Another dot. Again on a length, Usman looks to cut it but misses.
Comes 'round the wicket. Good length delivery outside off. There is extra bounce on this one. Khawaja is surprised by it and pulls away from his attempted cut.
False start! Shami may have missed his run-up there as he pulls out in his delivery stride.
Single to end the over. Good length delivery on off, Khawaja brings down a straight bat and then opens the face at the last moment to guide it towards third man. End of another tidy over by Bumrah.
5th dot ball of the over. Length delivery outside off, Khawaja hits it straight to the fielder at point.
Length delivery outside off, tempting Khawaja to have a go at it. Khawaja obliges and goes for it but misses.
Bumrah pulls back his length on this occasion and bowls it outside off. Khawaja looks to cut but misses.
Comes 'round the wicket and bowls it full on off. Khawaja gets on his front foot and drives it to the fielder at point.
Full length delivery on off, Usman drives it straight to the fielder at mid off.
The away swinger now! Length and outside off, left alone. Another maiden from Shami, the Indian bowlers are bowling really well here.

Make that 5 and this is probably the best ball of the over. Pitches around off and on a length. Jags back in sharply. Stoinis tries to adjust at the very end but it hits the inside edge of his bat and then hits him near the box. Marcus is down in some pain. He takes a breather and rightly so. All set to continue now.
This one is wider outside off, Stoinis is in no mood at going after those. 4 dots in a row here.
On the 5th stump line, Stoinis watchfully lets it through to the keeper.
Marcus Stoinis is not happy with the sightscreen. There maybe someone walking across it. The issue is resolved and the action is set to resume.
Inside edge! Back of a length and on off, it pitches and then comes back in a little. Hits the inside edge of Stoinis' bat and then hits his pads.
Good length and outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to this one.
Good length delivery just outside off, Usman hits it to just wide of the fielder at cover point. Shikhar Dhawan moves to his left and stops the ball. 5 runs off the over.
Good length delivery on off, Khawaja again drives it to the same fielder at cover.
Length delivery on off, Khawaja drives it beautifully but straight to the fielder at cover.
Follows the boundary with a dot ball. Full length delivery on middle and leg, Usman hits it to the fielder at mid on.
FOUR! Khawaja gets going here. Good length delivery on middle and leg. Usman rocks onto his back foot and pulls it beautifully through backward square leg for a boundary.
This time Bumrah misses his line. Bowls a length delivery down the leg side, Usman looks to flick but misses. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, Khawaja hits it to the fielder at mid off.
Full length delivery on off, Stoinis hits it towards mid-wicket through the inner half of his bat. 5 runs off the over.
FOUR! Excellent shot. Full length delivery on off, Stoinis gets on his front foot and drives it through mid off with pure timing.
Length delivery on the fourth stump line, Stoinis offers no shot to it.
Good length delivery outside off, Marcus leaves it alone.
Wide! Shami misses his line and sprays this down the leg side. Stoinis looks to flick but misses. Dhoni dives to his left and fumbles but then gathers it.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Marcus looks to block it off his front foot. He gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Fuller length delivery on the stumps, Marcus looks to defend. He does so with the inner half of his bat.
Excellent start from Bumrah. Inswinging delivery on off and middle. Khawaja misses it and gets hit high on the thigh pad.
Good length delivery on off stump, Khawaja defends it with straight bat.

Hesitation but then safe! Firstly a lovely confident stroke by Stoinis through covers. Kohli gives it chase from covers. The batsmen complete two. Khawaja then wants the third but Marcus is not sure. Khawaja then stops but then sees Marcus then go for the third. Khawaja then continues running. The throw from Kohli is to Dhoni. By the time the throw gets to him, both the batsmen make it in. Heart-in-mouth for the visitors as they would have not wanted to lose two in two.
Marcus Stoinis replaces his skipper in the middle and walks out at number 3.

OUT! Edged and taken! Bumrah strikes in his third ball itself and Australia have lost their first wicket very early and that too of their skipper. He can't buy a run at the moment, his last five innings' scores are - 11, 6, 6, 14 and now a duck here. Top but this. It is once again bowled on a length and angled into the off pole. The batter has to play at it but it pitches and then straightens. Finch tries to defend but the ball takes an outside edge to Dhoni who takes a simple catch. The crowd here are going bonkers.
Goes fishing there does Finch but gets beaten. Length and way outside off, Finch need not play at that but still reaches out for it and tries to defend but gets beaten.
Bumrah like Shami starts off with a delivery outside off. Finch like his partner, leaves it alone.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Good length delivery outside off and Khawaja starts carefully. He leaves this alone and it is a maiden to begin with.
Excellent, this one. Good length delivery outside off, Khawaja looks to poke at it but the ball goes past the outside edge as there are extra bounce and away swing on this.
Away swing on this one. Shami lands it on a length outside off. Khawaja shoulders arms to it.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Usman looks to defend but gets an inside edge on it. The ball goes to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length delivery outside off, no swing on this one and it goes away with the angle. Usman chooses to leave it alone.
Shami starts with a full length delivery outside off. There is a hint of swing on this one. Khawaja leaves it alone.

We are done with the National Anthems and are all set to begin. The Australian skipper, Aaron Finch walks out with Usman Khawaja to open the innings. Mohammed Shami to take the first new ball for India.
Out walk the both set of players for the national anthems.

Indian skipper, Virat Kohli, wanted to bowl first as they have done well chasing. Mentions the ball might just come nicely onto the bat under lights. Further adds he wants to continue the same cricket played by them in New Zealand and Australia. He reckons they are a balanced 11. Informs Ravindra Jadeja and Kuldeep Yadav are the spinners and Vijay Shankar is also in the team, giving them more depth in the batting.

Australian skipper, Aaron Finch, says they are going to bat first as it looks like a dry surface. Mentions the stats also influences his decision to bat first. Further adds they are looking to improve with each series and they are doing so. Informs Alex Carey comes in and Jhye Richardson misses out from their last game. The other change which he forgets to mention is that Usman Khawaja is also back, replacing D'Arcy Short.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in the favour of the visitors. Finch wins the toss in his 100th ODI and elects to bat first.

Ambati Rayudu in an interview near the sidelines. States he is happy to bat anywhere the team wants him to. On batting at number 5 at Syed Mushtaq Ali trophy for Hyderabad, Rayudu says that it was just according to the situation. Admits that the approach is different while batting at different positions and explains he is flexible in his head which helps him bat in various positions. On how he bounces back from the downfall he faces - Rayudu explains it is important to be composed and balanced and work on his shortcomings. Adds that he did not think too much about it. On his innings in the 5th ODI vs New Zealand, Rayudu mentions that they had lost the game in Hamilton and the middle order was disappointed with the performance and it was a happy moment for them to perform in the last ODI and win the game.

Hello and welcome! Hyderabad is bustling with excitement and so are we. The last leg of international fixtures for the Men in Blue ahead of the massive World Cup upcoming at the end of May. The Australians are on a roll with a couple of wins in the 2 games already on this tour. Onto the 50-over format then, can the visitors continue their winning momentum or will the home team prove too strong? Ashton Turner is in line for his ODI debut as Matthew Hayden is seen presenting him with the cap. What will the team combinations be? How will the surface play? Who will bat/bowl first? All that coming up real soon with the Toss just around the corner!
